name: American Express Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer Credit Card
highlights: S$1 = 2 KrisFlyer miles on eligible Singapore Airlines & Scoot flight bookings, KrisShop & Pelago purchases, with no cap
S$1 = 1.1 KrisFlyer miles on all other eligible purchases
KrisFlyer miles directly credited into your KrisFlyer account

Receive S$150 Cashback for use on your next eligible purchase on singaporeair.com or the SingaporeAir mobile app with a minimum spend of S$800 in a single transaction, when you spend S$12,000 or more on eligible purchases with your Card within the qualifying period.

citation.title: American Express Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer Credit Card

extra.summary: The Amex KrisFlyer Credit Card offers a fast track to KrisFlyer miles, especially for SIA loyalists, with accelerated earn rates on Singapore Airlines, Scoot and KrisShop purchases. Meeting the S$12,000 spend unlocks S$150 cashback for your next purchase on singaporeair.com or the SingaporeAir mobile app, incentivizing concentrated spending.
badges: Most convenient way to earn KrisFlyer miles

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Interest Rate: 27.80% p.a. compounded if payment of the closing balance in your statements is not made in full; or 3% p.a. on top of prevailing interest rate in the event that your account has three or more defaults in the last 12 months
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Principal Fee: S$179.85 (incl. of 9% GST), waived for the first year
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Supplementary Annual Fee: S$54.50 (incl. of 9% GST) waived for the first year for the first 2 Supplementary Cards.

minimum-income-requirements.Singaporean/PR Minimum Annual Income: Card application is subjected to customers meeting the regulatory minimum income requirement and internal assessment.
minimum-income-requirements.Non-Singaporean Minimum Annual Income: Card application is subjected to customers meeting the regulatory minimum income requirement and internal assessment.

our_takes.our-take: The Amex KrisFlyer Credit Card offers a fast track to KrisFlyer miles, especially for SIA loyalists, with accelerated earn rates on Singapore Airlines, Scoot, KrisShop & Pelago purchases. Waiving the first-year annual fee lowers the barrier to entry, making it ideal to test the card's value. Meeting the S$12,000 spend unlocks S$150 cashback for your next purchase on singaporeair.com or the SingaporeAir mobile app, incentivizing concentrated spending. However, the 3.25% foreign transaction fee makes it less attractive for frequent overseas spending.
our_takes.good-for:
For frequent flyers aiming to accumulate KrisFlyer miles on Singapore Airlines and Scoot flight bookings, KrisShop and Pelago purchases.
For frequent flyers who want to enjoy hassle-free conversion as all KrisFlyer miles earned are conveniently credited directly into your KrisFlyer account.
our_takes.things-to-note:
S$179.85 annual fee applies after the first year; consider if the KrisFlyer miles earned justify the cost.
27.80% p.a. interest rate applies if balances aren't paid in full, significantly increasing debt.
Foreign transaction fees of 3.25% apply, adding costs to overseas spending, so use alternative cards abroad.
